title: Small Held Items
description: Keep your eyes locked onto your opponent's crosshair position, not your giant sword.
body:
🗡️ FluxSmall Items: The Ultimate Low-Profile PvP Resource Pack
Tired of bulky default vanilla models blocking your field of view during intense, high-stakes PvP encounters? Welcome to FluxSmall Items, a meticulously optimized, competitive resource pack designed from the ground up to completely scale down and reposition first-person held items.

By drastically reducing the visual footprint of your arsenal, this pack delivers unparalleled battlefield awareness, ensuring that your crosshair remains completely focused on your opponent—not on your oversized sword.

🎯 Purpose & Function: Honest & Clean Performance
Let's be fully honest and transparent: this resource pack does NOT modify game engines or artificially boost your hardware's FPS. Instead, it introduces a massive computational and visual optimization for competitive play.

By changing the model matrices and translation layers of held assets, it completely removes the generic blind spots that default Minecraft items create. You get a cleaner, wider visual field of view (FOV) natively, without tweaking your actual game configurations or relying on third-party modifications.

⚡ Comprehensive Feature Breakdown
⚔️ Scaled-Down Short Swords & Tools: Swords, axes, and pickaxes have been physically shortened and lowered in the first-person perspective. Your weapon sits comfortably at the bottom edge of the screen, giving you full visual access to your opponent's footwork and movement vectors.

🛡️ Low-Profile Shields: Standard vanilla shields are notorious for blocking almost 40% of the right side of your screen when standing or crouching. This pack repositions the shield matrix so it sits much lower and tighter to the edge, keeping your vision unhindered even when guarding.

👁️ Mini Totems & Compact Utility Items: Totems of Undying, Bows, Crossbows, and Potions have been compressed into clean, mini-variants. When a totem pops or when you are actively charging a bow, your screen estate remains clutter-free.

📦 Light & Clean Code Optimization: Built with highly optimized, zero-lag JSON models. FPP contains absolutely no ghost folders, dead texture leaks, or unnecessary junk files, keeping your resource pack loading speeds instantaneous.

🛠️ Technical Specifications & Modern Integrity
Target Deployment: Engineered natively for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Pack Format Standarization: Set perfectly to Format 48 inside the pack.mcmeta initialization script to offer native support for modern rendering engines.

Modern Directory Structuring: Fully updated to comply with modern item rendering standards. All asset directories use the singular nomenclature standard (e.g., mapped directly under assets/minecraft/textures/item/ and block/ instead of legacy plural names) to prevent broken vanilla textures or missing asset glitches.

📜 Modrinth Content Rules Compliance
This project strictly complies with Section 2.1 of Modrinth’s Content Rules. It provides an absolute, transparent, and accurate overview of its visual mechanics, features zero misleading performance metrics, contains high-integrity compiled assets, and delivers a pure, unadulterated tactical competitive advantage.

👑 Created By: FluxHeart
